get.description:
A package's inclusion proof: the whole chain from its first event through the recording event of the
first valid seal covering the package's last event (or the chain head, unsealed), with that seal and
what checking its signature needs. Self contained; trust in the signer's key must come from outside
it. Refused (mixed-scope) on an installation with more than one organization, which share one chain.

ok.description: The global chain verifies and the proof holds.

check.description: The bundle checked on its own: links from the first event, the package's events derived from it, and the seal's signature.

head.description: Unsealed: the chain head when the bundle was made, which the segment must end at. Unauthenticated.

get.description: The run's story: its normalized events in order, after a sequence number.

post.description:
The owner queues a new run in place of one that was lost, failed or stopped. The old run
keeps its record. Repeating returns the run already queued.The owner stops a run. A queued run stops at once. For a running run the request is
recorded first, then the daemon is told in its next log reply and ends the process; the run
shows as stopping until the daemon confirms. Repeating is harmless.

receipt.description: The spawn receipt, sent until the control plane has recorded it.

events.description: Normalized events since the last post.

events_from.description:
How many of this run's events the daemon had delivered before this batch. The control plane
keeps each event once by its index, so a batch resent after an upload whose answer was lost
is not recorded twice.

get.description: Runs that are queued or running, across every package, for the floor and board.
What the daemon last reported about each runtime it found, for the office.

pins.description: The active pins, per runtime and role.

get.description:
The SCRAMs in force in the viewer's organization (not yet restarted for their whole scope).
Presenting, each is a ScramPresented.

run_count.description: How many runs it stopped where they stood.

stopped.description: Present once every run in scope has stopped: the stop latency (OV-12).

get.description:
What pulling SCRAM with this scope would stop now, by the pull's own selection: the runs running
(stopped where they stand) and queued (held). The pull selects again when it fires.
Presenting, only the counts.

running.description: The runs themselves; left out when presenting, where they would name restricted work.

get.description: A SCRAM, the runs it stopped with their quarantine and reviews, and its restarts.

stopped.description: Present once every run in scope has stopped: the stop latency (OV-12).

subject.description: What the run worked on: a package, or a capture for intake.

packages.description: Every package the SCRAM reaches, so a staged restart names one it holds; lifted once a restart covers it.

get.description:
Usage (plan task 5.2; specification 26): every budget and its use this window, the latest usage
records, and per runtime how many finished runs reported tokens, so missing telemetry reads as missing.

near_share.description: The share of a limit at which a budget reads as near it, from the approved policy (budget_near_percent); null when unset.

command.description: The command or decision, for example "release" or "draft.edit".

authority.description: Any one of these roles or authorities may take it.

missing.description: Qualifications the viewer lacks for it, in words.

ActionDescriptor.description:
One command for an object and the viewing Member (workbench specification 5.7): allowed or
refused, why in words, what would change it, how it is signed and the authority it needs.

need.description: "member", or authorities joined by "+" (any member, or each listed authority).

AdminCommandInfo.description: An administrative command and what it needs (specification 10.2).

credentials.description: Each passkey's current state: every Member's for an administrator, otherwise the viewer's own.

delegations.description: Every delegation, with whether it was revoked, and without its reason.

AdminRegistry.description: Each Member's current qualification, passkeys, delegations, bindings, open change requests and budgets.

id.description: The run the figure stands for.

state.description: The five states (OV-02); each always carries a cause.

cause.description: Why, in words: what it is doing, what you must decide, who it waits on, what blocks it, which input changed.

spend.description:
The tightest budget that applies to this agent's work (organization, its project, or its
baseline) and how far along it is this window; absent with no budget, and never when presenting.

cause_key.description:
The recorded thing behind the cause (a SCRAM, a hold, an input revision, the dependencies
awaited, or the run itself), so agents are grouped by what holds them, never by matching words.

waiting_on.description: Who it waits on, by name, when waiting.

since.description: When the present state began, so a reader sees how long.

place_defaulted.description: True when the discipline is unset or unmapped, so the figure stands in Process by default.

gate.description: A gate decision (release or accept) waits on this package.

changed_input.description: The input that changed, when one did.

loop.description: The run's round, when past the first.

marks.description: At most these marks besides the state shape (OV-06).

unverified_inputs.description: Recorded inputs whose freshness is unknown, because no preparation basis pinned their revision.

current_inputs.description: Package inputs the preparation pinned that are still at the pinned revision: freshness established.

gate_stage.description: The nearest gate, for the Gate lens.

observability.description: Recorded once a permission wait cannot be observed for this runtime (print mode, plan task 2.9).

project_id.description: The project that owns the work, for the portfolio rollup; absent for organization level work.

run_status.description: The run's own status, so the card offers stop exactly when the command layer would take it.

stop_requested.description: A stop was asked for and the daemon has not yet confirmed it.

AgentFigure.description:
One agent on the office floor (AgentFigure, specification 13 and 18; plan task 4.6), projected only
from recorded data: the package (or, for intake, the capture), its latest run at the current
revision, what the Inbox routes to the viewer, SCRAM holds, effective markings, recorded
dependencies and the revisions a preparation basis pinned. Never guessed from terminal output.

code.description: A stable reason code (services/api/src/refusals.ts lists every one).

change.description: The one fact that would change the answer (WB-03).

floor.description: Set when a floor refused: no person, decision or setting lifts it.

capture_id.description: For a held intake run: the capture it reads (no package exists yet).

binds.description: The sentence a signer reads: what the digest covers.

decisions.description: Decisions the viewer may take on it now.

waiting_on.description: For an item waiting on someone else: who, and why not the viewer.

AttentionItem.description:
One thing waiting (AttentionItem, specification 5.11). Decisions state what a signature binds;
risk orders the Inbox (gate risk, then age).

AttentionTarget.description: Where an item opens: a page, and for a package which one and which section.

Auth.Options.description: WebAuthn options as JSON, passed straight to the browser API.

used.description: Used this window (settled at measured value, open reservations at full size); null when the unit is not reported.

in_flight.description: Of that, what open reservations hold for runs not yet settled.

unreported_runs.description: Tokens: measured runs in the window that reported no complete counts.

BudgetStatus.description: One budget and what it has used in its current rolling window.

Caller.description: The viewing member, as the command layer knows them.

disposition.description: Intake either answers a quick question directly or drafts a work package.

answer.description: The direct answer for a quick question. No package, check or approval.

lane.description:
The data lane a person with lane authority classified this capture into. Until it is set,
nothing from the capture goes to any runtime or provider (specification 11.3 M-0).

effective_lane.description: The capture's effective lane (specification 11.3 M-3), shown wherever it appears.

Captures.Classification.description: Classifies a capture's data lane. Needs lane authority; a capture's lane can be raised, never lowered here.

Captures.IntakeState.description: The latest intake run for a capture still pending, so a failed intake is never stranded.

text.description: Typed text plus any attachment fences; the visible text is capped at 20,000 characters.

lane.description: Classifies the capture at once when the sender holds lane authority; otherwise it waits unclassified.

artifacts.description: Complete published output set when this source is a package dependency.

ControlRod.Preparation.CriterionResultSe.description: Controller binds admitted checker results to the actual normalized verification record.

assignment_digest.description: Assigned baseline/runtime/round; changing them invalidates the grant.

path.description: Relative to the dedicated input root, never the workspace/host root.

package_digest.description: Canonical stored WorkPackage body at release, independent of the lifecycle column.

custody.description: Admission is not proof of tool execution or model consumption.

ControlRod.Preparation.RequirementsConfi.description: Stored only by the later verified passkey and kernel confirmation path.

ControlRod.Records.Actor.description: Who acted. Agents and the system can never hold a human decision right.

ControlRod.Records.AttestationFormat.description: The attestation statement format a registration returned. "none" means no attestation.

limit.description: The limit with its unit, for example "USD" or "tokens".

disposition.description: Intake either answers a quick question directly or drafts a work package.

answer.description: The direct answer for a quick question. No package, check or approval.

lane.description:
The data lane a person with lane authority classified this capture into. Until it is set,
nothing from the capture goes to any runtime or provider (specification 11.3 M-0).

ControlRod.Records.Capture.description: Something a person said they want done, before intake turns it into a package.

impact.description: Downstream objects the change affects, listed before approval.

proposal.description: The proposed content (for a policy change, the policy set body); its digest is subject_digest.

ControlRod.Records.ChangeRequest.description: A change only an authorized person may approve, over an exact subject version. (L)

ControlRod.Records.Coupling.description: Independence of one axis of the actor and evidence coupling profile.

ControlRod.Records.DataLane.description: Data handling class. Decides runtimes, egress, storage and transcription.

subject_digest.description: Digest of the package revision, output and pre-check record the person reviewed.

challenge_nonce.description:
The one-time nonce the passkey challenge was built from, so the binding of the signature to
this subject, kind and revision can be re-verified from the record alone. Absent on decisions
recorded before it was kept.

ControlRod.Records.Decision.description: A person's decision on one package revision. Bound to the digest of what they saw.

ControlRod.Records.DesignInput.description: A controlled document this package relies on, by reference and revision.

ControlRod.Records.Event.description: One entry in the append-only event log. Each entry carries the digest of the one before.

runtime_mode.description:
How the runtime was driven. "print" is a headless, one-prompt run (`claude -p`, `codex exec`)
where no ACP permission binding is in force; "acp" is reserved for ACP sessions.

requested_model.description: The model the run asked for, or "default" when it left the choice to the runtime.

reported_model.description: The model the runtime said it used, read from its own event stream. Absent when it did not say.

permission_mode.description: Permission mode the runtime started in, when it has one.

allowed_tools.description: Tool allowlist passed to the runtime, when it takes one.

sandbox.description:
The sandbox the run was launched under: `native-cli:<policy id>@v<version>` for an agent CLI
under its recorded sandbox policy (plan task 6.2), or "none" for the test runtime. Runs recorded
before plan Phase 6 carry the request they made then ("workspace-write" and the like).

ControlRod.Records.ExecutionTrace.description: Proof of where outputs came from. Recorded by the runner, never by the agent.

deadband.description: Allowed change before consumers must re-check, for example "5%" or a Quantity string.

expires_on.description: Last day the license is valid, as an ISO date.

ControlRod.Records.License.description: A professional license as the Member recorded it.

user_name.description: The WebAuthn user name the Member's passkeys were registered under.

office_theme.description: The Member's own office theme: a bundled theme and the digest of its manifest when chosen.

ControlRod.Records.Member.description: A person in an organization. Passkeys bind here; only a passkey session of a Member is a person.

ControlRod.Records.Mode.description: Kind of work a project does. General is the base layer with no domain pack.

cumulative.description:
Usage: true when the counts are the whole run's so far (a runtime's final result), not one
step's, so they replace the steps' counts rather than add to them.

dropped.description: How many events admission refused before this one (kind dropped).

ControlRod.Records.NormalizedEvent.description:
One normalized thing an agent did (specification 20), built by the daemon from each runtime's own
output so the browser only renders. Text is clipped; tool inputs are kept as a digest and a short
plain summary, never in full.

ControlRod.Records.OwnerOverride.description:
A person's choice to proceed past a hold, with who, when and why, signed with their passkey
over the digest of (package, revision, run, the act and the reason).

pgid.description: The process group the run's process leads.

process_start.description: The process start time in the operating system's own units (Linux: clock ticks since boot).

boot_id.description: The kernel's identifier for this boot; a reboot changes it.

containment.description:
cgroup: the run has its own systemd user scope, which the daemon can freeze and kill as one
and which reports when it is empty. process-group: the fallback without a user systemd.

ControlRod.Records.OwnershipReceipt.description:
Proof of which process a daemon started for a run (specification 22). A stop, sweep or kill acts
only while the live process still matches: same boot, same process id, same start time.

reason.description: Why this package waits for that one.

ControlRod.Records.PackageDependency.description: A package this one waits for.

ControlRod.Records.PasskeyAssertion.description: A WebAuthn assertion over the decision digest, made by the person's own authenticator.

subject_digest.description:
The digest the person signed: package, revision, the decision subject (outputs and pre-check)
and author run, sorted criteria and outcome. The challenge was SHA-256 of
"<subject_digest>|person-verification|<challenge_nonce>".

ControlRod.Records.PersonVerification.description: A qualified person's verification of a candidate for Safety or Material work. (A)

hardware_attestation_formats.description: Attestation formats accepted as evidence of a hardware backed key (docs/sqa/authenticators.md).

settings.description: Floor settings by name, each a short string value.

ControlRod.Records.PolicySet.description: Floors and settings in effect. Decisions reference a policy set by digest.

ControlRod.Records.PreCheckIndependence.description: Runtime identity of author and checker, and whether they could be the same.

autonomy_level.description: Autonomy level. Level 4 is never permitted (specification 11.2).

ControlRod.Records.Project.description: A project: its mode, default rigor, admitted lanes, QA overlays and autonomy level.

unit.description: Unit in Pint-compatible notation, for example "kW" or "degF".

ControlRod.Records.Quantity.description: An engineering quantity. The value is a decimal string so no precision is lost.

disposition.description: discard: the partial work is not used. retain: kept as reference only, never applied.

covers_batch.description:
The newest quarantine batch this review saw for the run; absent when the run had reported
nothing. A batch that arrives later needs a review of its own before a restart.

ControlRod.Records.QuarantineReview.description: A person's signed review of one run SCRAM stopped, whose output was quarantined. (A)

disposition.description:
completed-late: the daemon's completion arrived after the run was marked lost; it is retained,
never applied. process-gone: the daemon proved from its receipt that the process no longer runs.
abandoned: a person signed that the run will not report, with a reason.

ControlRod.Records.Reconciliation.description: How an unknown outcome was settled.

ControlRod.Records.RigorMode.description: Graded rigor: how much control a package requires.

round.description: Author and pre-check rounds start at 1; round 3 escalates a dispute to a person.

preparation_manifest_digest.description: Controlled preparation basis; absent for historical legacy runs.

label.description: Short label the runner writes for the office view. Never raw model text.

lease_expires_at.description: While running: when the claim lapses unless the daemon renews it with a log post.

requeue_of.description: The run this one was requeued from, after it was lost, failed or stopped.

requeued_as.description: The run the owner queued to replace this one.

stop_requested_at.description: The owner asked to stop this run. It shows as stopping until the daemon confirms.

scram_id.description:
The SCRAM that stopped this run (specification 22a). Whatever the run reports afterwards is
quarantined: retained privately with its digests and never applied until a person reviews it.

budget_ceiling_seconds.description:
The run ceiling its budget reservation was sized from, in seconds (the daemon's timeout and
graceful stop ladder). The control plane asks the run to stop once it has run this long.

sandbox_policy.description:
The sandbox policy version its agent actions run under (workbench plan task 6.1), by digest.
The daemon refuses a job whose policy does not match it.

reserve_minutes.description:
The minutes a reservation for this run takes (its ceiling and the control plane's margins,
rounded up), recorded whenever the daemon reported a ceiling, budget or not, so a minute budget
set while the run is in flight counts it at that size.

waiting_reason.description: Why a queued run is not being handed out, in plain words.

waiting_cause.description: The kind of hold, so it reaches whoever may resolve it (the Inbox routes on it).

waiting_key.description:
What the hold waits on, where one decision resolves it for every run that names it: a lane's
admission, a runtime pin for a role and the runtimes it was offered, or a budget's hard cap. Absent when the hold is
the run's own (a preparation, an unclassified source, an independence conflict, a SCRAM).

independence_override.description: The owner let this pre-check run on the author's runtime. Recorded before it ran.

generation.description:
Which attempt this is at its package revision, role and round, counting from 1. Reports from an
attempt a later one superseded are refused (the generation fence, specification 22).

receipt.description: The process the daemon spawned for this run, as it recorded it at spawn.

outcome_unknown.description:
Set when the run was dispatched but its exit or completion was never observed (specification
9 and 22). It holds requeue until a reconciliation records what happened.

reconciliation.description: What settled an unknown outcome, and the evidence for it.

grace_renewals.description:
Lease renewals granted without a heartbeat (after a controller restart, a machine sleep or an
apparent outage). At most one is granted until a heartbeat proves the run alive, so no number
of restarts keeps a dead run running.

permission_waits.description:
Whether this run can show that it needs a person's permission (plan task 2.9). observed: a
Claude Code PermissionRequest hook reports each request. not-observable: Codex exec mode gives
no such signal, so a refused action shows only as a failed tool call.

ControlRod.Records.Run.description: One agent session working on one package revision in one role.

ControlRod.Records.RuntimePin.description: Which artifact version a role launches. Changes are directly signed commands. (L)

denied_read.description: Paths agent actions can never read; always includes the CLI login folders.

allowed_hosts.description: Hosts agent actions may reach; empty means no network.

enabled_tools.description: Agent tools enabled for the run; anything not listed is off.

mandatory_claims.description: Claims the in-run probe must observe before the verdict counts.

ControlRod.Records.SandboxPolicy.description: What a run's agent actions may touch. Decisions and traces cite its digest. (F per version)

ControlRod.Records.SandboxPolicyRef.description: One version of a sandbox policy, as a run cites it.

project_id.description: Present exactly when the scope is a project.

quarantine.description: Run ids stopped, with their outputs quarantined.

drill.description: A practice pull: everything is stopped for real, and the time to stop is recorded as a drill.

ControlRod.Records.ScramEvent.description: Who pulled SCRAM, where, why, and what was stopped. (A)

package_id.description: Present exactly when the scope is a package.

discipline.description: Present exactly when the scope is a discipline.

ControlRod.Records.ScramRestart.description:
A staged restart after SCRAM (specification 22a): directly signed, with a reason, for one package,
one discipline, or everything the SCRAM stopped. Refused while anything in its scope has an
unknown outcome or unreviewed quarantine. (A)

ControlRod.Records.SignerAuthority.description: Authorities this specification needs beyond signing roles.

ControlRod.Records.SignerGrade.description: Grades a signer may sign at.

revoked.description: A revoked version grants nothing; revocation is a new version, never a deletion.

reason.description: Why this version was issued or revoked.

ControlRod.Records.SignerQualification.description: What a Member is qualified to sign and administer. One frozen version per change.

ControlRod.Records.SignerRole.description: Roles a signer may hold on a package.

ControlRod.Records.TenancyId.description: A stable identifier: a lowercase type prefix, an underscore, then up to 64 letters, digits or hyphens.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the executable that ran (specification 21: runs launch a verified artifact).

verifier_receives.description: What the verifier may see. Never the author's transcript.

independence.description: Whether the checker ran on a runtime other than the author's, and any owner override.

ControlRod.Records.VerificationRecord.description: Evidence that a result met its criteria. Inconclusive never counts as a pass.

grade.description:
The quality grade signers must hold (workbench specification 5.2). Absent means General service,
as for every package drafted before grades existed.

design_inputs.description: Citations: documents this package relies on. They never decide when the package may start.

depends_on.description: Packages this one waits for: it starts only once each is accepted. Unknown targets are refused.

ControlRod.Records.WorkPackage.description: The only unit of work an agent may start.

DigestLine.description: A line of the "since you last looked" digest, in words.

FigurePlace.description: Where a figure stands in the office (specification 13): a discipline's cube set, or a room.

state.description: near only when the approved policy sets budget_near_percent; partial when some runs reported nothing.

unreported_runs.description: Tokens: runs that reported no complete counts, so use is at least `used`.

FigureSpend.description: A budget as a figure carries it. `used` is absent when the budget's unit is not reported.

findings_caught_before_review.description: Findings the pre-checker raised that the author fixed before you saw the work.

median_review_minutes.description: Median minutes from the work reaching your office to your decision.

median_minutes_to_done.description: Median minutes from capture to acceptance.

Metrics.description: Whether Control Rod earns its place: measured per accepted package.

scram_id.description: For a run a SCRAM holds: that SCRAM, so a view that must not show its reason knows these words carry it.

OfficeItem.description: One entry in your office: something that needs a person.

draft_etag.description: Strong ETag of the current draft's content; send it as If-Match to edit the draft.

effective_lane.description: The package's effective lane: its own lane raised by everything it was derived from (11.3 M-1).

subject_digest.description: Digest a decision on this revision must be bound to.

binds.description: What a signature on this revision binds, in words (drafts and work in verification).

PackageView.description: What the web app shows for one package: the revision, its runs, output and decisions.

expected_subject_digest.description:
The subject digest the person was shown. The server refuses the options request when the
package has changed since, so a person never signs content they did not see.

criteria.description: Criterion ids: a prepared package's criteria, or AC-1, AC-2 and so on for acceptance criteria.

Packages.PersonVerificationRequest.description: What a qualified checker verified in person (specification 11.5).

subject_digest.description:
The digest the person signed: package, revision, the decision subject (outputs and pre-check)
and author run, sorted criteria and outcome. The challenge was SHA-256 of
"<subject_digest>|person-verification|<challenge_nonce>".

package_revision.description: The package revision whose candidate was verified.

PersonVerificationEntry.description: A recorded person verification with the package revision it verified.

hardware.description: Whether it meets the hardware key floor under the policy in force now.

RegistryCredential.description: A passkey as the forms name it: its owner, when it was registered, and no attestation evidence.

RegistryDelegation.description: A delegation as the forms show it: who, what, when, and whether revoked; never its reason.

RegistryQualification.description: A Member's current qualification as the forms show it: no license numbers and no reasons.

pinnable.description: Whether a runtime pin can be set for it (preparer roles launch by their own custody path).

baselines.description: Each runtime and baseline pair recorded on its runs; empty until something has run it.

rollback.description:
Per runtime with an earlier, different artifact to roll back to: the artifact pinned now and the
one a rollback restores. A rollback signs both; if either changes first, it is refused.

RosterRole.description: One run role on the Roster: what it does, who has run it, and its pins.

idempotency_key.description: Chosen by the daemon once per completion and kept across retries.

status.description: "stopped" only after the owner asked to stop the run.

receipt.description: The run's spawn receipt, so it is on record even if no log post carried it.

containment.description:
What proves the run's processes ended: cgroup (its scope is empty), process-group (the
leader and its group are gone; a process that left the group is not seen) or none (no
process was started). Absent means no proof: a failed or stopped run then keeps an unknown
outcome.

events.description:
Events no log post delivered (the last upload failed), carried by the completion, which the
daemon retries until it is recorded. Indexed from events_from like a log batch.

refusal.description: Set when the completion could not be applied; the run is then recorded failed with this reason.

Runner.CompletionReceipt.description: What the control plane recorded for a completion. A repeat with the same key returns it again.

inputs.description: For a pre-check: only the deliverable and criteria, never the author's transcript.

claim.description: Custody of this run: present the token on every log and completion.

runtime_pin.description: The artifact this run must launch, when one is pinned for its runtime and role.

sandbox_policy.description:
What the run's agent actions may touch (plan task 6.1). The daemon derives every CLI setting
from it, checks it against `sandbox_policy_digest` and the run's recorded policy, and refuses
to launch an agent CLI without it.

stop.description: End the agent process when the owner has requested a stop.

heartbeat_seconds.description: Post a log batch, even an empty one, at least this often.

Runner.RunClaim.description: A claim on one run. Log posts renew the lease; a lapsed lease marks the run lost.

Runner.RuntimeArtifact.description:
A runtime's native executable and its SHA-256. A runtime whose npm launcher wraps a platform
binary with helper files (Codex) is identified by a digest over that whole platform directory.
Script launchers whose own digest would not identify what runs are refused.

Runner.RuntimePinRef.description: The artifact a run must launch, from the pin for its runtime and role (specification 21).

login_checked.description: The CLI could say whether a login is present. The probe never signs in.

artifact.description: The executable the probe checked: its resolved path and SHA-256. Runs launch exactly this.

Runner.RuntimeStatus.description: The daemon's probe of one runtime it found: whether it is ready for work, and why not.

ScramPresented.description: A SCRAM as presenting mode shows it: that it holds and over what, never its reason or runs.

ScramQuarantineBatch.description: One quarantine batch: what a SCRAM-stopped run reported in one completion, as digests.

stopped.description: Present once every run in scope has stopped: the stop latency (OV-12).

ScramTiming.description: When a SCRAM was pulled, and once every run it reached has stopped, how long that took.

result.description:
valid, or why not: the head moved or is missing; no chain.sealed event records this seal as it is;
the subject does not match its payload; the signer's key is unknown, was not enrolled to the signer
before the seal, has changed since it was recorded with the seal, or was revoked before the seal was
recorded; the signature fails; or the chain breaks before its head.

SealCheck.description: One seal as verification found it.
